items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: when he's working with all these people and Sarah, and all these people.

ctx.x: I will always say -- I always say that somebody is one of the best. I never say anybody who is the best of anything. I mean like -- I would say to me, who is the best piano, the best one, who is this guy saying who is the best. And just remember now how can I say that, and I worked with Ella, I worked with Billy Eckstine, I worked with Frank Sinatra, I worked with Joe Williams on and off, the
best, that's a hell of a thing for me to say with me when he's working with all these people and Sarah, and all these people. How can I say that.
